overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the notice-specificity complaint, declined to review the personal-remarks complaint as outside the law, and declined a later-raised allegation not in the original complaint. No remedy ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the September 16 meeting notice topic on Town Hall Improvement Committee resignations was not sufficiently specific.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no violation with respect to the allegation that the notice for the Board’s September 16 meeting was insufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the chair made disparaging, personal remarks about a resigning committee member during the September 16 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because an allegation of a personal attack, even if true, would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law, we decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Later email alleged the board failed to discuss the complaints openly at its October 14 meeting and refused to have them read aloud; not in the original complaint.
